data.name: मारोती
data.long_meaning: The name मारोती (Mārōtī) is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Mārā’ (Maruts) and ‘Tī’ (Mother). This name signifies the mother of the Maruts, a group of wind gods in Hindu mythology. Maruts were believed to bring rain and prosperity, and their mother was revered as the goddess of fertility and abundance.
